Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?
Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!
HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.
Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.
